label: 2026-10-07-fix5
method: GRADER_PROMPT.md; filters + hours + price visible; median of every reviewer's vote per case

atl-authentic-southern.reason: Mary Mac's, Southern Queenz, Virgil's and Twisted Soul fit, but for 'most authentic' the #2 slot is an upscale Buckhead new-American spot (The Chastain) and #4 is a Nashville hot-chicken chain (Hattie B's), while Atlanta's canonical soul-food institutions are absent.

atl-best-southern-lower.reason: Mostly genuine southern/soul kitchens led by Mary Mac's; The Chastain at #2 is a stretch and Busy Bee Cafe is a notable absence, but a local would accept this list.

atl-southern-food.reason: Mary Mac's plus a solid set of soul-food and southern kitchens across the metro; Busy Bee Cafe would be expected but the list is a fair answer.

near-tiramisu.reason: Italian restaurants that serve tiramisu are reasonable, but Jim's Burgers is junk and two 85°C chain-bakery branches rank above the Italian spots.

near-coffee.reason: Eight coffee shops/cafes all within about a mile of the traveler, which is exactly what 'coffee near me' wants.

near-best-tacos.reason: All results are well-reviewed taquerias in Arcadia/El Monte within ~6 mi, a fair local answer for best tacos.

tokyo-things.reason: Sensō-ji, Tokyo Tower, Skytree and Meiji Jingu are right, but three of the top eight are in Kyoto/Osaka (Fushimi Inari, Kinkaku-ji, Osaka Castle, 229-249 mi away) and the regional strip pads with an office building and a shopping complex (Tokyo Station Marunouchi Building, Iidabashi Sakura Terrace).

paris-museums.reason: Orsay, Louvre, Orangerie, Arts et Métiers, Arts Décoratifs, Art Moderne and the Natural History Museum are exactly what a visitor expects.

naples-pizza.reason: Port'Alba and a Sorbillo outpost are legitimate, but Naples' most famous pizzerias are absent while a trattoria and lesser-known fried-pizza spots fill the list.
missing: Gino e Toto Sorbillo (Via dei Tribunali)

statue-bare.reason: Returns the Statue of Liberty itself, its museum and the Battery Park viewpoint - exactly right.

theater-not-food.reason: Mostly multiplex cinemas with a shopping mall at #2 as junk, and no live stage theater for a traveler who may mean a play.

great-views-not-food.reason: Obscure roadside pullouts with 14-24 reviews, several 28-32 mi away, instead of the region's well-known viewpoints.

atmosphere-not-atm.reason: Only five results, led by a Mimi's Cafe chain and a fast-casual boba spot, with nothing indicating a genuinely cozy setting.

charge-phone-not-pho.reason: Convenience stores and pharmacies sell chargers but are not places to sit and plug in, and the results lack distances and review counts.

cheap-eats.reason: All $-priced, well-rated nearby spots (Marugame Udon, Jim's Burgers, The Original Tops, Yi Mei), satisfying the price filter.

rooftop-bar.reason: Only Hipico Rooftop is actually a rooftop venue; the rest are ordinary bars, and an Elks Lodge and an Indian restaurant break the bars-only filter.

souvenirs.reason: A mall, Sanrio stores and generic gift shops (one with a single review) instead of places that sell local or LA souvenirs.

taipei-night-market.reason: Ningxia, Nanjichang and Guangzhou St are right, but Taipei's two most famous night markets are missing, while Ximending (a shopping district) and daytime markets (Qingguang, Linjiang 7AM-2PM) fill slots.

ramen-at-hotel.reason: For 'near my hotel' the top five are 13-24 mi away in West LA and Downtown, ranked above the only nearby options (El Monte/Pasadena at ~5 mi).

atv-hawaii.reason: The top two (and Apex Mopeds, Slingshots Waikiki) rent mopeds or Slingshots rather than ATVs; only Kualoa Ranch and Coral Crater actually run ATV/UTV tours.

nyc-kids-2-6.reason: Generic indoor play spaces in New Jersey and Staten Island (up to 21 mi away) instead of the NYC attractions a visiting family with toddlers would want.

older-teens.reason: Sim racing, escape rooms, a rage room, an arcade and an immersive exhibit are fitting teen activities within reasonable range, though the laser tag place is closed today.

tokyo-matcha.reason: All results are matcha cafes, but they are newer Ginza/Tsukiji stands with modest review counts, and Tokyo's renowned tea houses are absent.

tokyo-fresh-sushi.reason: 'Fresh catch' implies market sushi, but the list is tourist sushi spots plus a conveyor chain (Kura) and a vegan sushi place, with no Toyosu or Tsukiji market counters.

tokyo-ramen.reason: #1 is a 3.7-rated Odaiba food-court ramen hall, halal-wagyu tourist spots (one typed hamburger_restaurant) take three slots, and Tokyo's benchmark ramen shops are missing; Tsujita is the only strong pick.

la-pancakes.reason: Gram (soufflé pancakes), The Griddle Cafe and Du-par's are genuine LA fluffy-pancake answers, though Pancakes R Us 22 mi away at #2 is an odd pick.

la-pancakes-full.reason: Identical to the short form: Gram soufflé pancakes, The Griddle Cafe and Du-par's answer the ask, with Pancakes R Us 22 mi away as a weak #2.

bohol-zipline.reason: Chocolate Hills Adventure Park, Danao and Loboc Eco Adventure Park are correct, but #1 is the Chocolate Hills viewing deck and a waterfall, a café and a 2.8-rated theme park are mixed in.

paris-croissant.reason: The top results are a sandwich chain, a crêperie, a matcha café, brunch cafés and a bánh mì/donut shop near the Louvre rather than the boulangeries famous for pain au chocolat; only Union Boulangerie and Brigat' fit.

london-fish-chips.reason: The Seashell is a right #1, but the rest are review-heavy West End tourist chippies and London's classic chippies are missing.

germany-beer.reason: Munich beer halls, gardens and brewpubs (Hofbräuhaus, Löwenbräukeller, Waldwirtschaft, Giesinger) are a fair answer, though Augustiner is a notable omission.

london-strawberries.reason: The Portobello chocolate-strawberry stall and the chocolatiers fit, but a sandwich shop, a Whittard tea store and an Italian café chain are junk in the top eight.

spain-seniors.reason: Results are adult daycare and municipal senior centers for residents, not activities a traveling senior would want.

madrid-capital.reason: Botín, Lhardy, Casa Labra and Casa Lucio are the classic Madrid institutions, with well-rated tapas spots after them; the brunch café is the only soft pick.

sd-seafood.reason: Pete's, El Pescador, Tom Ham's and Water Grill fit, but an Italian restaurant and a steakhouse are in the top five and the city's best-known seafood market spot is missing.

sd-marketside.reason: Point Loma Seafoods is the right #1, but two steakhouses, an Italian restaurant and an American bar fill the list instead of other fish markets that cook to order.

la-steamed-crabs.reason: Mostly crab-boil specialists (L.A. Crazy Crab, Boiling Crab x2, Crab Avenue, Oh My Crab); a Peruvian spot and a supermarket are minor filler.

redondo-crabs.reason: Quality Seafood on the pier is exactly the local answer for crabs and leads the list, followed by other pier seafood spots; the shabu-shabu and grill at the bottom are filler.

la-beaches.reason: Real LA beaches, but the two most famous (Santa Monica and Venice) are absent while a beach house venue and Mothers Beach rank high.

nyc-view.reason: Clustered around Rockefeller Center and mostly bars or lounges; The View (Marriott Marquis) fits, but La Grande Boucherie and Jupiter have no real views, and Centurion is open to Amex members only.

cebu-view.reason: Results are view-type spots (rooftops, Ocean Park) but mostly obscure low-review places in the city flats; the classic Busay/Talamban hillside view restaurants are absent.

la-beachside.reason: Big Dean's, The Albright, Back on the Beach, Coast, Gladstones and the Marina del Rey spots are genuine oceanfront answers.

sd-beachside.reason: Almost all are harbor/bay-front (Harbor Dr, Harbor Island, Shelter Island, Mission Bay) rather than beachside; the true on-the-sand La Jolla/Coronado restaurants are missing.

seattle-beachside.reason: #1 (2120) and Charlotte are inland downtown hotel/restaurants with no beach; the rest are Elliott Bay waterfront, and Seattle's actual beach restaurants at Alki/Shilshole are missing.

maine-lobster.reason: Solid Portland lobster/seafood set (Luke's, Portland Lobster Co, Street & Co, DiMillo's, Scales, Bite Into Maine); Portland is a fair proxy for 'Maine', though Eventide Oyster Co is a notable absence.

thailand-street-food.reason: Jay Fai and Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu are right, but a closed coffee stand, a vegan cafe and Khaosan tourist restaurants fill the list while the famous neighbor Thip Samai and Yaowarat stalls are absent.

manila-bay-street-food.reason: These are sit-down Nepali, Mexican, Vietnamese, Japanese-chain and bakery restaurants spread into Makati, not street food anywhere near the bay.

dlsu-street-food.reason: Same sit-down international restaurants and a Makati bakery; none is the cheap student street food around Taft/Agno that the ask means.

tijuana-tacos.reason: Only #1 is a real taqueria; the rest are torta shops, a tlayuda place, a burrito stand with 15 reviews and a bar, and Tijuana's famous taco names are missing.

tokyo-vegan-no-in.reason: All results are genuinely vegan spots including well-known Vegan Bistro Jangara and Veggie Sushi; a fair answer.

ba-vegan-capital.reason: Correctly resolved to Buenos Aires and nearly all are dedicated vegan restaurants (Mudrá, La Reverde, La Vegana, Konu, Falafelandia).

arcadia-shaved-ice.reason: No shaved-ice shop appears; it returns ice cream, froyo, a cheesecake counter, a bakery, a burger stand and a Burmese restaurant in an area full of Taiwanese shaved-ice shops.

positano-pasta.reason: Half the list is outside Positano (Sant'Agnello 4.8 mi over the mountain, an Agerola pizzeria, a Praiano bar) and the #1 is a tiny takeaway, while Positano's known pasta spots are missing.

barcelona-couples.reason: Four of eight are escape rooms; a couple wants romantic experiences, and the classic sunset/spa/landmark answers are absent.

nyc-statue-view.reason: Results are Midtown/Central Park/Queens restaurants with no Statue of Liberty view; only ONE Dine (#8) plausibly sees the harbor.

nyc-propose.reason: Mix of fair picks (Boathouse, One if by Land, ROBERT) with no-view places like Avra and Soothr, and the city's iconic proposal-with-a-view restaurant is missing.

vegas-burgers.reason: All burger joints, led by the obvious Gordon Ramsay Burger, with credible local favorites like Stay Tuned and Sickies.

vegas-buffets.reason: Bacchanal and Wynn are right, but two all-you-can-eat sushi restaurants outrank Wynn and the famous Strip buffet Wicked Spoon is missing.

la-kbbq.reason: Park's, Jeong Yuk Jeom, Quarters, Road to Seoul and Genwa are legit Koreatown KBBQ, though #1 is a rice-bowl shop.

nyc-brunch.reason: Barney Greengrass is a classic but the rest are generic Midtown spots (a bar & grill, a diner) while NYC's famous brunch destinations are absent.

nyc-empire-bridge.reason: Magic Hour and Nubeluz do face the Empire State Building, but ROBERT, Riverpark and two Williamsburg restaurants have no such view and nothing offers a Brooklyn Bridge view.

london-farmers.reason: Borough, Marylebone, Queen's Park, Brockley, Blackheath and Pimlico Road are exactly the markets a Londoner would name.

tokyo-affordable.reason: Gyukatsu Ichinisan, Tsujita and Age.3 are good cheap eats, but #1 is a sweets shop and #3 is a maid café tourist attraction, not delicious affordable food.

pasadena-late.reason: Only three Pasadena places pass the late filter (Ventanas just at 11 PM), and #4 is a 2.5-rated spot 18.8 miles away near LAX.

near-from-here.reason: These are genuinely the closest restaurants around downtown Arcadia, though none show ratings or hours to help choose.

hilton-manhattan.reason: The Hilton was never located, so results cluster at Columbus Circle as unrated listings with no hours, some of which may be stale; the traveler can't tell if they're near their hotel.

g-locals-shibuya.reason: Top two are a board-game cafe and the Shibuya Crossing viewing deck, plus Neal's Yard-style and Oslo brewery spots; only the ramen/oden places fit 'where locals eat'.

g-authentic-pho.reason: All genuine pho shops in the SGV near Arcadia plus Pho 87; fair, though San Gabriel's Golden Deli is a notable absence.

g-cdmx-markets.reason: Coyoacán, San Juan and Mercado El 100 fit, but three are City Market supermarket branches and La Ciudadela is a crafts market, while the great food markets are missing.

g-sf-moscone-late.reason: Late-hours filter holds and Cocobang/Taniku/Fanoos are fair, but #1 is Vesuvio, a North Beach bar a mile away that is not a food answer.

g-hk-quick-lunch.reason: Yat Lok, TamJai and sen-ryo fit, but Arbor (3-Michelin-star tasting menus) and Bo Innovation are the opposite of a quick lunch and the classic Central noodle shops are missing.

g-rome-gf.reason: All dedicated gluten-free spots in central Rome; a celiac traveler would be well served.

g-seoul-halal.reason: All halal, including well-known EID and the Itaewon cluster plus central options near City Hall/Myeongdong.

g-singapore-business.reason: Peach Garden OCBC, San Shu Gong, Lerouy, Artemis and 15 Stamford are credible business-dinner venues, though a banquet listing leads and the top hotel Cantonese rooms are absent.

g-lisbon-wifi-coffee.reason: These are generic specialty coffee shops with no sign of wifi or outlets, most close by 3-5 PM, and several (the mill, Hello Kristof) are small brunch-style cafés poorly suited to laptop work; Copenhagen Coffee Lab and Fábrica are the only clear fits.

g-london-quiet-cafe.reason: Generic busy cafés around Trafalgar/Soho with no sign of quietness; Notes and Café in the Crypt are among the noisiest tourist spots for a call.

g-sf-third-wave.reason: The Coffee Movement and Coffee Bar fit, but #1 is Bluestone Lane (a chain) and Fresh Brew is a plain café, while the defining SF third-wave roasters near Union Square are missing.

g-seoul-aesthetic.reason: Nearby generic cafés with no patio evidence (#1 Center Coffee is in a basement), missing the famous hanok-courtyard Instagram cafés.

g-marais-bakery.reason: The French Bastards, Bo&Mie, Rose Bakery and Marais coffee spots are a fair local answer despite a Le Pain Quotidien chain.

g-austin-cold-brew.reason: Just the nearest downtown coffee shops (not top rated) with a brewery mixed in on the word 'brew', missing Austin's best-known coffee names.

g-near-me-now.reason: No open-now filter was applied for a 'right now' ask, so 626 Night Market shows even though it is closed today, and a neighborhood pocket park and a bar outrank the area's real draw, the Arboretum, which comes last.
missing: The Huntington Library, Art Museum and Botanical Gardens

g-mbs-hidden.reason: These are literal keyword matches on 'secret', 'gem' and 'hidden' (a crystal shop, a gem museum, a business called HIDDEN), not lesser-known spots near Marina Bay Sands.

g-rome-walking-tours.reason: The top five are real Rome walking-tour operators with strong reviews; the generic 'Rome' pin and a 2-review company at the bottom are minor junk.

g-istanbul-landmarks.reason: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Dolmabahçe and the Basilica Cistern lead the list, which is a fair answer. Topkapı Palace and Galata Tower are missing while minor Hippodrome monuments fill slots.

g-dallas-after-5.reason: The 'after 5 pm' limit is ignored: 5 of 8 results close at 5 PM (the Arboretum, Perot, DMA, and the Sixth Floor Museum, which also appears twice as 'Book Depository'); only Gamebox, Reunion Tower and Klyde Warren Park fit.

g-tokyo-speakeasy.reason: Most results are ordinary cafes, craft-beer and Belgian beer bars, and a burger joint around Chiyoda; only JANAI COFFEE and maybe Bar Akamon are hidden-style bars.

g-bellagio-running.reason: The Strip has no dedicated running path, so the nearest real parks with paths (2–6 mi, led by the popular Sunset Park) are a fair answer, though the 3.3-rated Pecos-McLeod trailhead is filler.

g-vancouver-hikes.reason: The Grouse Grind, Quarry Rock, Dog Mountain, the Baden Powell Trail and Eagle Bluffs are the classic North Shore hikes a local would name; the only flaw is Quarry Rock appearing twice.

g-orlando-kids.reason: The popularity sort pushes perfect-5.0 escape rooms and game-show rooms on International Drive into the top five, ahead of the theme parks and family attractions Orlando is known for.

g-restroom-near.reason: After Newcastle Park, seven slots go to duplicate unnamed 'Male/Female Bathroom' pins in the same mall, and Arcadia County Park (0.2 mi, which has public restrooms) and the public library are missing.

g-station-restroom.reason: The results are the station itself plus nearby stations, exits and the bus terminal, some listed twice, rather than actual restroom locations inside Shinjuku Station.

g-atm-fees.reason: Nothing reflects fees: a 'merchant services' pin at a park address is #1, and a Bitcoin ATM, a gas-station ATM and unbranded ATMs (the highest-fee kinds) sit beside the only sensible picks, Chase and Citibank.

g-exchange-weekend.reason: These are the Myeongdong, Insadong and Namdaemun money changers (MoneyBox and others) that are the standard answer for exchanging cash in Seoul, and they keep long hours.

g-best-rates.reason: Only two results: a crypto ATM and a check-cashing/remittance shop, and neither is a good place for competitive foreign-exchange rates.

g-247-store.reason: The 7-Elevens, ampm and Shell are correct 24-hour picks, but CVS Pharmacy (closes 9 PM) and Walgreens (closes 10 PM) break the app's own 11 PM filter, and 'open 24/7' itself was never enforced.

g-supermarket.reason: Grocery Outlet, Trader Joe's, Ralphs, ALDI and Vons nearby are exactly right; only the #1 slot, a 1-review 'Whole Foods Bakery' sub-listing, is odd.

g-adapter.reason: The results are generic shopping malls, several 7–12 mi away, plus two night markets (one closed today), with no electronics, big-box or pharmacy store that reliably stocks adapters.

g-organic-grocery.reason: Only La Vie Claire is an organic grocer; the rest are generic supermarkets and late-night minimarkets, and the order ignores the 'nearest first' filter (1.4 mi listed before 0.2 mi).

g-milan-shopping-street.reason: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II is right, but most of the rest are souvenir kiosks, a minimarket and a food hall, and the famous shopping streets are missing.

g-dubai-malls.reason: The top four are junk (a 2-review 'online shopping center' and Deira discount stores); Dubai Mall only appears at #5 and is then split into sub-listings, and the other major malls are missing.

g-artisan.reason: These are real artisan cooperatives and craft shops in Centro (Casa de las Artesanías, MARO, Huizache, tinwork and textile shops), exactly what a traveler wants.

g-spice-market.reason: The Spice Bazaar itself is missing; the results are obscure foreign-language duplicate pins, general stores and a flower market.

g-salsa-clubs.reason: Only 1830 and Tropicana are real dance or show venues; the rest are Old Havana cafés and Hemingway bars, and the city's main salsa clubs are missing.

g-rooftop-romantic.reason: There are several real rooftops (SIN, The Speakeasy, Yào, Sanay), but a cannabis dispensary and non-rooftop Chinatown bars slip in, and Bangkok's iconic view bars are missing.

g-craft-beer.reason: Deschutes, Wayfinder, BeerMongers, Lucky Lab and the taphouses are genuine local craft-beer spots; only the hotel restaurant Proof•Reader is filler.

g-happy-hour.reason: The bars-only filter leaks: a coffee shop that closes at 6 PM is #1 and an office 'business center' is listed, with steakhouses and restaurants filling the middle; only BXL Cafe, The Long Room and AperiBar are real happy-hour bars.

g-late-dessert.reason: The hours fit, but for a 'near me' ask three results are 17–24 mi away in West LA and Hollywood, and a 0-review soy-sauce 'bakery' is filler, while San Gabriel Valley has plenty of late dessert spots.

g-lisbon-dessert.reason: Pastéis de Belém, Confeitaria Nacional and Versailles are right, but the global chains Häagen-Dazs and Amorino take slots for a 'famous local' ask while Manteigaria is missing.

g-rome-gelato.reason: Giolitti is right, but most of the rest are tourist-zone shops near Trevi, and Rome's most acclaimed gelaterias are missing.

g-vegan-dessert.reason: The top five vegan bakeries are right, but two ordinary Indian restaurants (Roots, Crown of India) and a full-service vegan restaurant fill the back half.

g-library.reason: These are the nearest public and college libraries, all open today, which is exactly the answer.

g-first-date.reason: The traveler said 'not loud bars', yet the app applied a bars-only filter and returned pubs, brewpubs and an Irish pub; only Zig Zag and Deep Dive are passable quieter date spots.

g-boba-date.reason: These are real boba and tea shops clustered at Diamond Jamboree and nearby Irvine (Sunright, 7 Leaves, TP Tea, Tastea), most with sit-down space.

g-dim-lit.reason: These are generic, busy Loop and River North restaurants (Siena Tavern, The Dearborn, a steakhouse) rather than the intimate, dimly lit spots Chicago is known for.

g-interactive-date.reason: Holey Moley, Puttshack and FTW fit, but the popularity sort pushes suburban family fun centers 8–10 mi out above them, and no bowling venue appears at all.

g-pottery.reason: All eight are real Brooklyn ceramics studios offering classes, nearest first, which is exactly the ask.

g-board-game-cafe.reason: Snakes & Lattes, The Guild House, Juju and the Twilight board-game cafés are right; a couple of plain cafés (Understory, Pinochio) are minor filler.
missing: Bampot House of Tea & Board Games

g-anniversary.reason: These are credible romantic, reservation-worthy French restaurants (Arpège, Le Sergent Recruteur, Boutary, La Calèche); a traveler would accept them.

g-budget-date.reason: Every result is $$ and an atmospheric, well-loved Covent Garden or Soho spot (Le Garrick, Dishoom, Mildreds, Kricket, Speedboat Bar): a strong budget-but-impressive answer.
